question: How many people were killed in the earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026?

steps.content: [2026 Flores earthquake] On 15 August 2026, at 05:58 WITA (UTC+8), a Mw 7.8 earthquake struck off the coast of the island of Flores in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. The earthquake was caused by movement on the Flores back-arc thrust fault located north of the island. Seismic observatories recorded a maximum Modified Mercalli intensity of VIII (Severe) on Flores. It triggered a tsunami with a maximum recorded height of 1.61 m (5 ft 3 in). At least 136 people were killed in the earthquake while another 1,776 people were injured. Approximately 98,900 homes were damaged, 27,400 of which collapsed or were badly damaged. | other articles: List of earthquakes in 2026, 2026 Venezuela earthquakes

The earthquake that struck off the island of Flores, Indonesia on August 15, 2026, resulted in at least 136 fatalities. Additionally, 1,776 people were injured, and significant damage occurred to homes in the area. 

FINAL: 136 people were killed.
